caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with a glass or transparent front panel, allowing the contents inside to be visible. Inside the box is a small figure of a woman with dark skin, wearing a short-sleeved red dress adorned with a skirt featuring yellow, green, and possibly white decorative details. The woman is standing on a floor with a blue and white checkerboard pattern. She is posed with her right arm bent upward, her left arm bent downward, and a red ribbon or scarf draped over both arms. The background inside the box features a green, scalloped valance at the top. The box itself has textured or patterned sides and appears to be made of wood or a similar opaque material with a brownish color. The name “DON HUMPHREY” is faintly written in uppercase letters below the box on the plain, beige background.
title: Dancing Doll in a Box
